video_title: Kevin Garnett on when he RUINED Michael Jordan and Scottie Pippen's workout & had to be kicked out 🤯

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett recalls being kicked out of a workout with Michael Jordan and Scottie Pippen
quotes.excerpt: He forced me to go hoop. And the whole time we was going down, we was going downtown to play the retroplex.

text_blocks.speaker: Kevin Garnett
text_blocks.text: He forced me to go hoop. And the whole time we was going down, we was going downtown to play the retroplex. You can never get in there, but today I guess his boy was working and we can get in. So we in down there, of course we can't get in, but Jordan in that motherfucker.

text_blocks.speaker: Kevin Garnett
text_blocks.text: So I'm like, man, why you have us come all the way down and we can't come down?

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: Billy, huh? Who brought you down there?

text_blocks.speaker: Kevin Garnett
text_blocks.text: Now my man brought us down there, but we couldn't get in. So when we get down there, Jordan rent the joint. So yeah, his man working, but Jordan not rented out. So can't nobody, so it's like all the guys who's going to play, we in here watching. So we lean on the guys watching him like, damn, MJ didn't play this shit. Damn, MJ still look good. Damn, look at Mike.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett describes the intensity of Michael Jordan's workout
quotes.excerpt: Scotty called for the ball, but when he clapped, Lord, it sound like I was like, this the clap.
quotes.quote: When we get in there, Scottie called for the ball, but when he clapped, Lord, it sound like I was like, this the clap. The clap. I got to bake. He said something like, I don't know how he put it, but I got one. He was calling for it like, let me, let me get it. And I never been right here. He shot the long ass three, but look regular. Like you know how you know when you league, you get that league shot. Man, Lord, he shot the longest three so much that I went like this. Boom. He was running back all smooth.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett recounts getting kicked out of a workout by Michael Jordan
quotes.excerpt: When I did that, Carl Harris jumped up. No, you can't do that in here.
quotes.quote: When I did that, Carl Harris jumped up. No, you can't do that in here. You can't do that in here. And I did that. He was hopped up. Game over. Everybody get out. Damn, you fucked up the run, young fella. Man, you going. Got security, woo woo. And then what's the little trainer? What's Mike trainer? Grover. Grover. Hey man, you can't. You can't come to the league with those eyes. You're not going to make it. The league doesn't play. All those guys you're with, they're not going to look, man, you fucked the game up, man. So I left that feeling like.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett recalls meeting Zeke at a workout
quotes.excerpt: The nigga raised up and only thing I saw was a collar. He turned his back to me.
quotes.quote: The nigga raised up and only thing I saw was a collar. He turned his back to me and there was a big dinosaur that said Toronto. And it was Zeke. What's up, boy? What you doing? I said, Zeke, what you got on? He had a big ass Aberex on and the collar was so high you couldn't see his face. And he had a dinosaur on his back and it said Toronto. I ain't know what he, yeah, what's up? I see you in here. I said, Zeke, man, I ain't mean to. I was trying to explain. Man, you saw that? You saw him? Boom, he was. Man, fuck it. Got him, man.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett discusses his decision to skip college for the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I need you to reach out to these agencies and call them. I ain't going to college no more.
quotes.quote: I said, man, look, this what we going to do. Tomorrow I need you to call Fault. I can't get the names. He was like, what? I said, listen, I need you to reach out to these agencies and call them. I ain't going to college no more. I'm going to the league.
